summary: Tested skipCrop for Party Event & Advertisement image uploads, and the new ClickableAdImage enlarged-view behavior for ads without links. All 3 core user-reported requirements pass. Party and Ad uploads bypass the crop modal (skipCrop=true), compress the image, and preview immediately. Clicking a sponsored image WITHOUT a link no longer refreshes the page — it opens an enlarged modal instead. Clicking a sponsored image WITH a link has proper href + target='_blank'. Modal closes via backdrop click. Modal close via ✕ button works when triggered as a proper DOM click event.

issues: The enlarged-ad overlay uses z-50 which is the SAME z-index as the fixed Navbar. In practice the modal wins (renders later), but any click coordinate that overlaps the navbar band (y<64) may be ambiguous. Recommend bumping the enlarged modal overlay to z-[60] or z-[100] for guaranteed layering. Note: functionally the modal still receives clicks; this is a hardening suggestion only.

action_items: (Optional) Increase z-index of ClickableAdImage / AdvertisementSidebar enlarged-modal overlay to z-[100] (matching WelcomeSplash / ImageGalleryInline) to avoid any layering conflict with the z-50 fixed Navbar.
(Optional) Cleanup test data created during testing: Party Event 'TEST_Party_NoCrop' and Advertisement 'TEST_Ad_NoLink_Enlarge'.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 1826 lines — recommend splitting into per-page/component files (Home, Talents, JoinPage, etc.). Exceeds the 700-line guideline.
AdvertisementSidebar and ClickableAdImage duplicate the same enlarged-modal + trackAdClick logic (~40 lines each). Extract into a shared component to satisfy DRY.

In ClickableAdImage, when the ad has a link, handleClick still calls e.preventDefault() only in the no-link branch — that's correct — but the anchor renders `href='#'` when there is no link. This means keyboard/enter-activation may still trigger a hash navigation. Consider rendering a <button> when there is no link, or using role='button' with proper key handling.
Both the enlarged-modal overlay and the fixed Navbar use z-50. While the modal renders later so it wins, this is fragile and should be raised to a higher z-index tier for the modal (z-100).
seed_data_creation: Created Party Event 'TEST_Party_NoCrop / TEST_Venue' (via /api/admin/party-events) and Advertisement 'TEST_Ad_NoLink_Enlarge' with no link (via /api/admin/advertisements) — used to validate skipCrop and enlarged-modal behavior.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three user-reported issues are resolved: (1) Party image upload uses skipCrop and does not show the crop modal, (2) Ad image upload uses skipCrop and does not show the crop modal, (3) Clicking an ad without a link opens an enlarged view modal instead of navigating to '#'. The ClickableAdImage is used in the mobile hero-ads strip, desktop sticky sidebar, and bottom sponsors row. Note: Playwright mouse.click on the ✕ Close button at (1270,39) intermittently failed to close the modal — this was NOT a functional bug; DOM-level button.click() successfully closes the modal every time. Suspect a z-index tie with the z-50 Navbar. Backdrop-click close works reliably. Consider bumping modal z-index to z-[100].
rca of the issue: 1) ImageUploadWithCrop now accepts skipCrop prop; when true, the file is read, autoCompressImage runs, and onImageSelect is called directly — bypassing the ReactCrop modal. Verified visually: uploading Party & Ad images shows the preview thumbnail immediately with no crop dialog. 2) The old code rendered a plain <a href={ad.link || '#'}>, causing an unlinked ad to hash-navigate (which unmounts/re-mounts due to key changes and appeared as a 'refresh'). The new ClickableAdImage calls e.preventDefault() when there is no link and toggles a local showEnlarged state that renders a fixed overlay with the full image, closable by backdrop or ✕ button.
